raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Background / motivation

Use the NVIDIA `ci` team for Autobot approval eligibility.

## What changed

- Replace `automation` with `ci` in `.github/autobot/review-config.yml`.

## Details

- Set `approval.eligible_teams` to `[ci]`.

## Tested

- `git diff --check` — passed.
- `python3` with `yaml.safe_load` — valid YAML; confirmed `approval.eligible_teams == ['ci']` and the exact one-line replacement against `origin/main`.
- `gh api orgs/NVIDIA/teams/ci --jq '{name,slug,organization:.organization.login}'` — confirmed team `ci` exists in `NVIDIA`.
- `git verify-commit HEAD` — good signature from `Oliver Koenig <okoenig@nvidia.com>`.

## Code provenance

No external code copied or adapted.
